clips.title: The story
paras: Feathermoon Stronghold is the premier night elf military base in southern Kalimdor, situated securely on Sardor Isle off the Forgotten Coast of Feralas. Commanded by General Shandris Feathermoon, this fortified outpost projects Sentinel strength across the wild forest and keeps watch over regional threats.

Perched on Sardor Isle across the channel from Feralas's mainland, Feathermoon Stronghold serves as the primary strategic base for the Sentinels in southern Kalimdor. Built among ancient elven groves and supplied with a sacred moonwell, the fortress houses archers, huntresses, and support staff under the direct supervision of General Shandris Feathermoon. From this insular sanctuary, the night elves project their influence over the verdant interior of Feralas, guarding against demonic corruption, hostile wildlife, and encroaching Horde expeditions.

Because the mainland of Feralas is thick with savage beasts, Gordunni ogres, and the tainted shadows of Dire Maul, Sardor Isle provides an essential defensive buffer. Alliance travelers rely on the ferry crossing from the Forgotten Coast to reach its fortified docks, repair their gear, and gather intelligence. The presence of Shandris Feathermoon—General of the Sentinels and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind's trusted right hand—ensures that the stronghold remains an unassailable redoubt against all enemies of the kaldorei.
